eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Yavapai, AZ; at 11:22 AM on JUL 26, 2026 Effective until 7:22 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
A SAFE Alert has been issued for Cottonwood, Arizona. This is the Department of Public Safety. Cottonwood Police Department is looking for 72-year-old George William Jackson. He is described as a white male, five feet eight inches tall, 150 pounds, with gray to white hair and green eyes. George was last seen on Sunday, July 26th, 2026, at 2:00 AM in the area Mingus Avenue and Willard Street in Cottonwood, Arizona. George was wearing blue jeans, a long-sleeved button shirt, a black vest and reading glasses. George suffers from a medical condition(s) and may become disoriented or easily confused. If you have any information about George, please contact Cottonwood Police Department.
